integrity: Proved analytical inequalities, beta-phase identities and exact finite-dimensional transfer operator; a standalone symbolic/rational checker supports finite and algebraic components. Invariant density, ergodicity and general diffusion concepts are acknowledged as prior mathematics. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact golden-phase moment formulas are for the invariant initial-phase distribution at the distinguished noninteger coefficient; this is not a classification for all noninteger coefficients. A compact absorbing interval is not a topological global attractor claim. No claims concerning cryptographic security or Gaussian limit laws are made.
title: A sharp confinement transition and exact golden-ratio transport statistics for a remainder-added linear map
